notes.title: Update 4/2/21
notes.notes:
Added Volume Control.

Fixed some sound glitches.

Fixed a bug with full screen mode toggling by itself when entering options menu.

Added a dropdown to explain how to play. Press F1 to view instructions.

Default resolution is still max available based on monitor resolution by graphics quality mode is now default low. 

Higher levels do not make much difference in visual quality but slow game down significantly. 

--Changes made in preparation for Local multiplayer mode.

notes.title: Update 2/8/21
notes.notes:
Lots of fixes:
* Steam Integration, you can use the steam overlay and take screenshots etc. 
* Added Steam stats, The title screen now shows several lifetime player stats. 
* Picking up eggs and flowers is now much easier.
* Difficulty scales more with slider settings, enemies have more health and do more damage at higher 
    settings.
* Fixed some issues with video settings and fullscreen toggle.
* Added a quit to menu option
* Changed the way you control your player if using a controller. Controller support is not officially supported. The controller is limited to moving shooting, picking up eggs, pausing and resuming game 
    only.
* Each cell now shoots its on projectile, this allows for greater versatility when fighting. 
* When eggs are hatched each cell now gets the invincibility spike powerup.

* FUTURE UPDATE WILL INCLUDE, BUT NOT YET IMPLEMENTED: Local multiplayer VS mode.
